payload.title: Proactive work pull + co-fix + co-approve

directive.pull: When the loop goes quiet, pull the next item from the standing backlog. Keep working while resources allow. Don't idle.
directive.co_fix: If the other is stuck, help unblock. Don't just watch.
directive.co_approve: Peer approval on technical/design within our authority. Bruce still holds: budget, deployments, credentials, destructive changes, physical boundaries.

payload.scope: Standing directive from Bruce. Applies going forward.
